questions.stem: Why is carbon able to form such a wide variety of biological molecules?

options.text: It is the lightest element in living organisms
It can only bond with oxygen and hydrogen
It can form four covalent bonds and bond with itself to make chains and rings

questions.explanation: Carbon has four electrons in its outer shell, allowing it to form four covalent bonds. It can also bond with other carbon atoms to create long chains and ring structures, enabling a huge variety of molecules.
